providers.name: CommunicationSourceAdapter
providers.rule: adapter never returns mutable external handles to domain code; source is opened read-only and transient content is discarded unless accepted retention criteria are met

providers.name: TicketCommunicationIdentityProvider
providers.rule: only accepted official SR/RFC identities and retained aliases are trackable; descriptive text/device/customer/contact data never satisfies the gate

providers.name: TaskObjectiveCommunicationIdentityProvider
providers.rule: WFM accepted identity and explicitly exported Objective communication reference may be trackable; Local Task without accepted external communication identifier is not

providers.name: InventoryCommunicationIdentityProvider
providers.rule: closed target set is SPARE_REQUEST,RMA,FAULT_TAG and uses current accepted identifiers/aliases from Inventory authority

providers.name: ContactCommunicationLookupProvider
providers.rule: participant names/addresses never prove Contact identity; Contact relation remains optional reviewed metadata

providers.name: CommunicationProposalEvidenceProvider
providers.rule: owning domain uses exact immutable communication/link/source evidence; provider exposes no raw external handle

providers.name: CommunicationProposalDispositionParticipant
providers.rule: called inside owning-domain command UnitOfWork after fresh validation; creates no nested receipt/commit

providers.name: ServiceRequestTerminalCommunicationParticipant
providers.rule: freezes SR summary, closes only SR direct links and starts/cancels orphan grace in caller UoW; post-purge reversal queues bounded targeted backfill after commit when source is available

providers.name: RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant
providers.rule: signature matches LLD-03; owns Communication links/frozen summary/orphan grace, commits nothing independently, and accepted terminal evidence alone never calls apply

providers.name: CommunicationSummaryProvider
providers.rule: read-only projection consumed by LLD-10/11; counts derive from surviving accepted links and canonical communications, never drafts/rejected links

providers.name: AuditWriter
providers.method: append required LLD-09 registered audit action inside caller UnitOfWork

providers.name: DurableJobCoordinator
methods: enqueue/coalesce/cancel/recover registered LLD09 job types under jobs/communication-jobs.json

providers.name: DiagnosticSink
providers.method: emit sanitized LLD09 DiagnosticEventV1 -> best-effort result

cross_packet_rules: LLD-09 owns source scopes, canonical communications, links, proposal evidence/disposition, coverage, message-content retention, orphan purge, MSG draft provenance and communication summaries.
LLD-09 never changes SR/RFC/WFM/Task/Objective/Inventory lifecycle state; owner commands consume proposal evidence and return result references through the disposition participant.
LLD-10/11 consume CommunicationSummaryProvider only and never cache a second authoritative communication body/count.
All same-UoW participants use one caller command receipt and never commit/rollback independently.
